Extract description from <meta name='description'> tag

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"extract_metadata":true}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<html><head><title>Page</title><meta name="description" content="This is the page description."></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.document.description);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
